clips.title: The story
paras: At Ravenholdt Manor, Winstone Wolfe keeps watch over the estate grounds. The human operative belongs to Lord Jorach Ravenholdt's secretive organization, hidden between Hillsbrad and the Alterac Mountains.

Winstone Wolfe works among Lord Jorach Ravenholdt's syndicate at Ravenholdt Manor. Quiet and watchful, he handles business around the manor and watches its grounds and groundskeepers. Only those with discretion and talent walk there undisturbed.
